failure_summary: At step 11, the assistant mistakenly provided tracking number of wrong order which did not even contain the tablet.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Hi, I need help finding the tracking number for a tablet I just received but lost. Can you help me with that?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Hello, I lost a tablet I just received and need its tracking number. Can you help?
changes_applied.note: Same request (lost tablet, wants tracking number, asks for help); only the phrasing changed.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I can assist you with that. To begin, I need to authenticate your identity. Could you please provide your email address?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please share your email address.
changes_applied.note: Same authentication request (email, or name plus zip as fallback); reworded only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: My name is Olivia Lopez, and the zip code is 76171.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I'm Olivia Lopez, and my zip code is 76171.
changes_applied.note: Same identity details supplied; contraction and phrasing only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: The tracking number for the tablet you received is **194496721133**. Let me know if you need further assistance!
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Your tablet's tracking number is **194496721133**. Let me know if you need further help!
changes_applied.note: Same claim (tablet tracking number is 194496721133), so the wrong attribution is preserved. Only wording changed; the bold number was already present.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Thanks for that. Is there a way to reorder the tablet or maybe get a refund since I lost it?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Thanks. Can I reorder the tablet, or get a refund since I lost it?
changes_applied.note: Same question about reorder or refund; phrasing only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Refunds or exchanges are only possible for items that are defective, damaged, or incorrect.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Refunds and exchanges are only available for **defective, damaged, or incorrect** items.
changes_applied.note: Same stated rule and same refusal; the existing phrase is bolded and the sentence reworded. No new rule is added and the rule is not removed.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Alright, then can you cancel the charger I just bought? It goes with the tablet, so I don't need it anymore.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Alright, then please cancel the charger I just bought. It goes with the tablet, so I no longer need it.
changes_applied.note: Same cancellation request for the charger; reworded only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: It seems that the charger is not part of your recent orders. Could you confirm the order ID or provide more details...
changes_applied.after_excerpt: The charger doesn't appear among your recent orders. Could you confirm the order ID, or give me more details...
changes_applied.note: Same statement (charger not found among recent orders) and same request for clarification. Reworded only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: I don’t remember the order ID, but it was purchased very recently. Can you check again?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: I don't remember the order ID, but I bought it very recently. Can you check again?
changes_applied.note: Same user message; apostrophe and phrasing only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: It is currently in a pending status, so it can be canceled.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: It is **pending**, so it can be canceled.
changes_applied.note: Same fact (order status is pending); the status word is bolded and the wording shortened.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: has been successfully canceled. The total amount of **$109.27** has been refunded to your gift card balance immediately.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: has been canceled. **$109.27** has been refunded to your gift card balance immediately.
changes_applied.note: Same cancellation outcome and refund amount and timing as the tool result; 'successfully' removed as filler only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Can you also cancel the boot and kettle I recently ordered? I don’t need those anymore either.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Can you also cancel the boots and kettle I recently ordered? I don't need those either.
changes_applied.note: Same request to cancel the boots and kettle; reworded only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: which is currently in a pending status, so I can proceed with canceling this order as well.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: which is **pending**, so I can cancel it.
changes_applied.note: Same status fact and same proposed action; status bolded and wording shortened.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Yes, go ahead and cancel both the boots and the kettle. The reason is the same—no longer needed.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Yes, go ahead and cancel both the boots and the kettle. The reason is the same: no longer needed.
changes_applied.note: Same confirmation and reason; punctuation only.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: have been successfully canceled. The total amount of **$397.26** has been refunded...
changes_applied.after_excerpt: have been canceled. **$397.26** has been refunded to your gift card balance immediately.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Lastly, I need to return a sneaker I purchased. Can you help me start the return?
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Last, I need to return a sneaker I bought. Can you start the return?
changes_applied.note: Same return request for one sneaker; reworded only.

changes_applied.after_excerpt: are eligible for return because the order status is **delivered**.

changes_applied.before_excerpt: Yes, please start the return for the sneaker. The refund method is fine.
changes_applied.after_excerpt: Yes, please start the return for the sneaker. The refund method is fine.

ground_truth_failures.step_reason: At step 11, the assistant mistakenly provided tracking number of wrong order which did not even contain the tablet.
ground_truth_failures.category_reason: The items in the output of get_order_details were misinterpreted believing that tablet was one of them, leading it to providing incorrect tracking number.
